note.title: Media and technology
note.specFocus: Phones, computers, the internet, apps, social media, online safety, advantages and disadvantages, digital habits, games, and media sources.
note.sourcePages: Original GCSE Spanish revision material; it is not an official AQA paper, mark scheme, or copied publisher content.
note.summary:
Media and technology

Key vocabulary
- el móvil; la aplicación; descargar; subir; la red social; la contraseña; navegar por internet; en línea; la cuenta; el ordenador; el riesgo; la pantalla; fiable; desconectar; ciberacoso

Key grammar
- Use desde/hace for duration, se puede + infinitive for general possibilities, por/para for reason and purpose, and conditional advice. Use indirect object pronouns for messages or help given to someone.

Exam tips
- Distinguish descargar (download) from cargar (load/upload depending on context). Balance benefits with risks and give safe behaviour, not just a list of devices.

questions.examTip: Translate sense units, not isolated words, and check tense and negatives before finalising each answer.
questions.modelAnswer:
1. I use my mobile to organise my homework and speak to friends.
2. My password is long and I change it every two months.
3. To learn, I search reliable sites and compare several sources.
questions.question:
Reading comprehension. Read the passage and answer in English.

“Uso el móvil para organizar mis deberes y hablar con mis amigos. Mi contraseña es larga y la cambio cada dos meses. Para aprender, busco páginas fiables y comparo varias fuentes.”

1. What is said in the first sentence?
2. What additional point appears in the second sentence?
3. Give the main idea of the final sentence.
